body:
KP-4.85 remains unresolved: this package does not construct a closed orientable smooth four-manifold whose full diffeomorphism identity component has unbounded commutator length. After two approaches, it records an ambient four-commutator bound for the stabilized subgroup f×id on M×S², following classical compression, and the exact obstruction to direct invariant-measure averaging. Neither subgroup, covering-group nor fragmentation conclusions are substituted for the target.

The source audit corrects the scope of existing uniform-perfectness results and identifies 30004403 / OWR-17471-009 as the same target. No novelty is claimed.

Validation: 6,570 exact author assertions reproduce byte for byte. A separate adversarial AI review passed the scoped deductions and source audit, with 228 independent exact controls and no mandatory corrections. The report and reproducible checks are included; this has not undergone human peer review. Only this problem’s attempt folder is changed.

Disposition: unsolved / stalled, 2 of 5 substantive approaches used. The duplicate target should share this outcome.
